 Regional Voices: Kyushu 
 One teacher’s lesson in the power of saying, ‘I need help’
 Teacher Narumi Hiramatsu poses by a classroom at Shingu Elementary School in Shingu, Fukuoka Prefecture. She says she worked together with students to decorate the classroom windows. 
 | Nishinippon Shimbun 
 NISHINIPPON SHIMBUN

 Nov 2, 2026 
 At a public elementary school in the town of Shingu, Fukuoka Prefecture, teacher Narumi Hiramatsu draws on her experience of living with hearing loss to teach children the importance of expressing their needs — and learning to help one another.
 “It’s important to tell people when you’re struggling. You need to let them know,” Hiramatsu, 32, tells her students at Shingu Elementary School. 
 Born with hearing loss, she once grew frustrated with people who, she felt, failed to understand her needs. What changed her mindset was advice from a mentor: “You have to speak up for yourself.”
